subject: general
question: Guru Shikhar Peak is the highest peak of which of the following mountain ranges?
solution:
Correct answer is__** Aravali Range.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Guru Shikhar, a top in the **Arbuda Mountains** of Sirohi district in Rajasthan, is the highest point of the Aravalli Range and Rajasthan.
 
• It stand up to a height of **1,722 metres (5,650 ft).**
 
• The system is split into two segment: the Sambhar-Sirohi ranges, taller and including **Guru Peak on Mount Abu.**
 
• ** Dilwara is the second top peak in Rajasthan, **and as Guru Shikhar is located in **Mount Abu**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​ The Western Ghats are the **mountainous criticize**** and ruined edge of the Deccan Plateau.**
 
• The Himalayas extend over** the northeastern portion of India**.
 
• The Eastern Ghats are a **intermittent range of mountains through India's eastern coast.**
